_comentario: Pistas de ambiente de la crónica. Las que tienen `prompt` se generan con Lyria 3 (tools/generar-musica.mjs) en assets/music/<id>.mp3; las que tienen `archivo` ya existen. `escena` enlaza la pista como ambiente de esa escena (se reproduce al activarla).

pistas.prompt: Slow, melancholic noir ambient music for an insomniac investigator's rented room at night: rain streaking the window, a red neon sign buzzing and flickering outside, a cork board covered in photos and red string, a single warm lamp, mould on the walls, cold mate and a full ashtray. A lonely muted trumpet or sparse tremolo electric guitar plays a few tired phrases over a soft upright bass and a low warm synth pad, brushed snare barely there, warm tape hiss and vinyl crackle, distant city hum under the rain. Lo-fi, dusty, paranoid but calm, very slow tempo around 60 bpm. Instrumental, no vocals, no fade-in or fade-out, steady volume from start to end, constant tempo, seamlessly loopable, about 2 minutes.

Relaxed, warm instrumental bossa nova for a quiet lounge, in the style of a late afternoon in Málaga. Soft nylon-string guitar comping the classic bossa rhythm, gentle brushed drums, upright bass, a mellow Rhodes piano and a sparse, lazy melody. Slow tempo around 70 bpm, mid-tempo groove, low energy, cozy and nostalgic. No vocals, no horns, no fade-in or fade-out, steady volume from start to end, constant tempo, seamlessly loopable, about 2 minutes.
